name: app-problem-definition-slide-with-lime-panel-and-pill-list
title: Problem definition slide with a lime panel holding three white pills
whatItIs: A white rounded slide with black border. Outlined pill tags 'Problem definition' and 'How might we' introduce sections; a large headline, two stat callouts (2.3x, 41%), a big lime panel with a problem statement on the left and three white capsule reasons on the right, and a lime pill saying the product is the answer.
whatItMeans: Clear, punchy and confident; lime panel signals the crux of the case study.
techniques: Use outlined pill tags as section labels.
Place a bright lime panel to isolate the problem statement.
List reasons as white capsules with small numbers.
Show two stats in plain type above the panel.
End with a lime pill that names the solution.

vocabulary.definition: A highlighted block stating the core problem.
A rounded list item with a small number.
A design-thinking question framing a challenge.
A bordered capsule labelling a section.
